- JoinFilterPushdownColumn: include/duckdb/execution/operator/join/join_filter_pushdown.hpp. CM functions: compress_integral.cpp.
- Perfect HA: plan_aggregate.cpp CanUsePerfectHashAggregate (perfect_ht_threshold).
- Distinct agg: physical_hash_aggregate.cpp distinct_data->radix_tables; RadixPartitionedHashTable::Sink at radix_partitioned_hashtable.cpp:548.
- Semi estimate: cardinality_estimator.cpp:264-271 (SEMI case uses left.denom*DEFAULT_SEMI_ANTI_SELECTIVITY).
- OptionalFilter is evaluated once per row group or segment; SelectivityOptionalFilter switches off when about 30% of rows pass.
- Noise: q04/q08/q17 ±5-15%; q16 threshold ~7.9%, q18 ~5%, q13 ~14%, q09 ~8.6%. Implementer-measured gains are often 2x the official ones, and the official bench may flag regressions on q16/q18 that the implementer reads as noise.
- Prior-run gains below ~10% on one template tend to fall just short of the bar officially (E0008, E0010). Prefer bundles or larger gains.
- Testing BF: compare against SET disabled_optimizers='join_filter_pushdown' on TEMP tables.

issues.title: OR-of-ranges scan filter as dense-mask ExpressionFilter
issues.hypothesis: q19 (190ms) now has per-table OR filters, derived by E0001's JoinDependentFilter, on lineitem/part (for example OR of l_quantity BETWEEN ranges). These filters are evaluated as generic ExpressionFilters through the expression executor with a selection vector, which costs a lot per row. A prior run measured q19 -7..-11% from evaluating OR-of-range conjunctions as a dense mask over the full vector and then gathering into the selection.
issues.plan: In the ExpressionFilter scan path (src/planner/filter/expression_filter.cpp, and the place in ColumnSegment/ColumnData where expression filters are applied), detect when the expression is an OR of comparisons/BETWEENs on the filtered column against constants. When the incoming selection is sparse or full, evaluate the ranges branch-free over the dense vector into a bitmask, then build the output selection from the mask. Fall back to the existing path otherwise.
issues.expected_gain: q19 -7..-11% (prior run); small gains for other OR-range filters
issues.generality: Any scan with an OR of range/equality predicates on one column (IN-ranges, bucketed filters). It could be slightly slower on tiny vectors with very sparse selections, which the gather handles.
issues.risk: Low-medium. Contained in the filter evaluation path; correctness of NULL handling must be checked.
